messages:
sam: Heads up — proposing a gpupool module bump to add AZ affinity + a lease_reconciler to reduce cross-AZ churn. PR incoming: terraform/providers/gpupool#412
alyssa: curious — what does the lease_reconciler actually do?
jordan: also curious about the IAM/KMS surface — last reorder blew up our gitops plans before.
sam: it pins pool nodes to preferred AZs based on topology spread and gives a short-lived lease so we don't bounce spots across zones. It also surfaces a kms_alias output so each pool can use a per-pool KMS key.
maria: per-pool KMS alias sounds fine, but we need to be careful with IAM policy attachments ordering. If attachments get recreated we'll trigger controller reconciles.
sam: yeah I hit that in my draft — terraform wants to add an aws_iam_role_policy_attachment because we're adding a conditional "kms:Encrypt" statement. Plan snippet: ```diff
~ module.gpupool.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.gpupool -> create
+ policy: allow kms:Encrypt on arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/alias/gpupool-xyz
```
alyssa: we should gate this behind an opt-in flag and canary the change to a single AZ first (us-west-2b). don't auto-apply to all pools.
jordan: Agreed. Also add a CI check: after plan run, export `terraform show -json` and run our reconcile-checker to detect IAM policy reorder/implicit replaces. Prevent merge if it reports destructive changes to iam/kms.
maria: cost / capacity note: AZ affinity will cut cross-AZ egress but may increase fragmentation (smaller leftover capacity per AZ). recommend reserved capacity or capacity leases for high-util pools. Tagging must be consistent for billing (`cost:pool`, `env`).
sam: plan is to release module v4.2.0 with opt-in vars: `az_affinity = true` and `lease_reconciler = { enabled = true, lease_ttl = "300s" }`. Migration docs will include steps and a safe rollout.
deploy-bot: CI triggered: terraform fmt, tflint, tfsec, plan.
jordan: after PR merge -> canary rollout: target us-west-2b with two pools, monitor node churn + kube node stability for 48h, then ramp 10% of pools every 6 hours.
alyssa: add rollback runbook snippet: set `az_affinity = false` in env override, `terraform apply`, then drain affected nodes: `kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120`.
maria: also update cost dashboard to simulate reserved vs on-demand for AZ-affined pools and flag any pools where fragmentation would exceed 20% (cost hit).
sam: I'll open the PR with docs, CI hooks, and a migration checklist. tagging you all for review. thanks.
